descriptions.online: Everyone can see you are around.
descriptions.idle: Shows you as away until you change it.
descriptions.dnd: No push notifications and no sounds. They still land in your list.
descriptions.invisible: You appear offline but can keep using Linkord as usual.

custom.title: Custom status
custom.description: Shown to anyone who sees you online: on your profile, in member lists and in conversations.

autoIdle.label: Go idle automatically
autoIdle.description: After a while without using this device, you show as idle. Applies to this browser only, and only while your status is Available.

errors.saveFailed: Couldn't change your status. Try again.
errors.offline: You're offline right now. Try again once you're back.
